hypothesis: Narrow-layer embedding plus layout conversion is expensive; direct tiled gather of both feature digits can reduce full-operator latency without changing arithmetic.
evidence: Iteration 010 narrow component diagnostic: embedding 216.197 ms and to_layout 80.179 ms per serialized forward; full unwrapped median 689.668 ms. Serialized times are not additive savings.
candidate: Use the archived iteration-003 direct tiled gather for each digit. Preserve ordinary embedding for non-tile-aligned chunk boundaries. Keep feature digit preparation, all four GEMMs, tile scale/bias and output assembly unchanged.
prediction: Avoid expanded row-major intermediates and subsequent tilize traffic. Potential cost: many small NoC reads, explicit tile clearing and barriers can erase savings, especially for wide input channels.
acceptance: Fixed correctness/workspace contract, full required corpus, then paired measurements beyond the existing noise rule. Screening alone does not promote.
